content.text: {"headline":"Approve P4: split overtime across payments and general plus the UPI outage message. Service level is predicted at 91.4% for 12:00–14:00, above the 80% target, for ₹6,660.","why":"The spike is caused by the UPI switch outage (INC-20261026-6474), not a campaign or absences. upi_payment_failed calls are running at 4.3x expected and account for about 296 of the 429 extra calls in the last hour. With no action, service level is predicted at 63.1% for 12:00–14:00, with 10.2% abandons. P4 offers overtime to 14 payments agents (12:30–14:30) and 6 general agents (13:00–14:30). It also plays an IVR outage message for UPI and payment-status callers and deflects 20% of balance and offer enquiries to chat. Predicted results are 92.0% on payments, 90.3% on general and 2.4% abandons. It is the cheapest plan that meets the target with no policy violations, and the rest-of-day figure is 93.1%.","trade_offs":["P3 (₹6,852) gives almost the same overall result (91.3%) but puts overtime only on payments. General would sit at 84.6% versus 90.3% under P4, so P4 is cheaper and safer for the other queue.","P2 costs only ₹1,272 but falls just short of target at 78.1% (payments 77.6%), with 5.4% abandons.","P1 (no-cost breaks and callbacks) is predicted at 61.7%, slightly worse than no action at 63.1%, so it does not help."],"watch":"Track how many agents accept the overtime offers; P4's numbers assume 14 payments and 6 general agents take it up. Watch upi_payment_failed volume and the status of INC-20261026-6474. If the outage runs past 14:00 or call volume keeps climbing, reassess and consider involving the duty manager."}
